acceptance_criteria: HTTP採用時はOpenAPIと実装が一致し、非採用時は適用外の根拠がある
scope: HTTP is an adopted profile. The OpenAPI document served by the app now describes every response body (contracts/http_jobs.responses.json). Its paths and methods match the app's routes (the document itself is the one undocumented route); every documented status of every operation is produced by a real request and validated against its schema, and no undocumented status occurs; the documented request schema decides acceptance, except the decimal-notation rule its description announces.
